messages.author: 009a6ed522b49af9
messages.subject: RMarkdown under RShiny on Ubuntu
parts:
Just installed a fresh Ubuntu server 14.04 in Amazon cloud with RShiny. Trying to add RMarkdown support as mentioned on welcome page but uncertain how to proceed.
Tried:
sudo su -c "R -e \"install.packages('markdown', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""
but still getting an error on the main page. 
Any help/suggestion would be most appreciated.
best
*P

Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : 
  You are attempting to load an rmarkdown file, but the 
rmarkdown package was not found in the library. Ensure that 
rmarkdown is installed and is available in the Library of the 
user you're running this application as.

messages.author: 5833f786297b5efd
messages.subject: Re: RMarkdown under RShiny on Ubuntu
parts:
Hi,

According to the error log (and I had the same issue on a ubuntu server), you first have to install curl, in libcurl4-gnutls-dev lib :

sudo apt-get install libcurl4-gnutls-dev
sudo su -c "R -e \"install.packages('RCurl', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""
sudo su -c "R -e \"install.packages('devtools', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""

and then, you can install the latest release of devtools :
sudo su -c "R -e \"devtools::install_github('hadley/devtools')\""

That should solve the problem :)

HTH,
Robin

On Wednesday, September 10, 2014 12:58:46 AM UTC+2, Robin Cura wrote:
Hi,

According to the error log (and I had the same issue on a ubuntu server), you first have to install curl, in libcurl4-gnutls-dev lib :

sudo apt-get install libcurl4-gnutls-dev
sudo su -c "R -e \"install.packages('RCurl', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""
sudo su -c "R -e \"install.packages('devtools', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""
and then, you can install the latest release of devtools :
sudo su -c "R -e \"devtools::install_github('hadley/devtools')\""

That should solve the problem :)

HTH,
Robin
